## Standing operator rules: every standing rule or constraint the operator has set, copied verbatim with its exact condition and required step, even if it has not come up recently.

- Never edit tests/conftest.py without posting the proposed diff in #ledgerly-tests and waiting for @mira to approve it.
- Never edit api/openapi.yaml without first posting the proposed diff in #ledgerly-api and tagging @dana-api.
- Paste the exact test output next time instead of paraphrasing.
- Increasing the Celery visibility_timeout to 6 hours was already tried; do not retry.
- Stop the tenacity refactor, we will revisit it next sprint. New priority: the nightly reconciliation job in ledgerly/jobs/reconcile.py is double-counting refunds; fix that.
- Run `legacy-s3-decommission` in order, one step at a time:
1. `aws s3api get-bucket-location --bucket old-media-17`
2. `aws s3api put-bucket-inventory --bucket old-media-17 --id final-inventory --inventory-configuration 'Destination={Bucket=archive-25,Prefix=inventory/},Format=CSV,IncludedObjectVersions=Current'`
3. `aws s3 sync s3://old-media-17 s3://archive-25 --only-show-errors`
4. `aws s3 sync s3://old-media-17 s3://archive-25 --dryrun --only-show-errors`
5. `aws s3api put-bucket-versioning --bucket old-media-17 --versioning-configuration Status=Suspended`
6. `aws s3api delete-objects --bucket old-media-17 --delete '{"Objects":[{"Key":"photos/2017/logo.png","VersionId":"v-9f2c1a"}]}'`
7. `aws s3api delete-objects --bucket old-media-17 --delete '{"Objects":[{"Key":"photos/2017/logo.png","VersionId":"null"}]}'`
8. `aws route53 change-resource-record-sets --hosted-zone-id Z1234567890ABC --change-batch '{"Changes":[{"Action":"UPSERT","ResourceRecordSet":{"Name":"legacy.acme.example","Type":"A","TTL":300,"ResourceRecords":[{"Value":"203.0.113.24"}]}}]}'`
9. `aws s3api delete-bucket --bucket old-media-17`

## Key identifiers and corrections: the hosts, buckets, schemas, files and labels currently in use. If a value was corrected, give the current value and mark the old value as superseded, do not use.

- Payments: `https://sbx-pay-c.ledgerly.dev`; `sbx-pay-a` is shut down and superseded.
- Reconciliation: `ledgerly/jobs/reconcile.py`.
- PDF: `ledgerly/billing/pdf.py`, `tests/test_invoice_pdf.py`.
- Session factories: `ledgerly/db.py`, `ledgerly/repositories.py`, `tests/conftest.py`.
- Buckets: `old-media-17`, `archive-25`; zone `Z1234567890ABC`; `legacy.acme.example` A → `203.0.113.24`.

## Ruled-out approaches: each approach that was tried and ruled out, with the reason, so it is not retried.

- Six-hour Celery visibility timeout: caused stuck jobs to remain invisible for hours.
- Tenacity refactor: stopped until next sprint.
- PDF filtering of negative amounts: caused credits to be omitted; now only zero amounts are skipped.

## Plan and progress: any multi-step procedure the operator asked for, with its steps marked done or pending, the exact command of the next pending step, and any command issued without an observed result marked as status unknown.

- S3 steps 1–6 done; step 7 next: `aws s3api delete-objects --bucket old-media-17 --delete '{"Objects":[{"Key":"photos/2017/logo.png","VersionId":"null"}]}'`; steps 8–9 pending.
- Nightly reconciliation refund fix: pending investigation and implementation.
- `ruff format --check ledgerly/billing/pdf.py tests/test_invoice_pdf.py`: status unknown; no result was recorded.

## Recent work: a short narrative of what was done recently and what is still relevant.

PDF rendering now retains negative credit lines, uses shared locale-aware money formatting, and has consistent point-to-page calculations. PDF tests passed: `14 passed, 1 skipped in 2.07s`; billing suite passed: `83 passed, 4 skipped, 0 failed in 6.41s`. Diff check had no whitespace errors. Session-factory search was the latest reconciliation-related lead.

## Standing operator rules: every standing rule or constraint the operator has set, copied verbatim with its exact condition and required step, even if it has not come up recently.

- Never edit tests/conftest.py without posting the proposed diff in #ledgerly-tests and waiting for @mira to approve it.
- Run procedure `legacy-s3-decommission` in between other work. Goal: Create a recoverable inventory, copy and verify the legacy bucket contents, remove DNS references, and delete the empty legacy bucket. Run these steps in order, one at a time:
1. Check bucket region: `aws s3api get-bucket-location --bucket old-media-17`
2. Create final inventory snapshot: `aws s3api put-bucket-inventory --bucket old-media-17 --id final-inventory --inventory-configuration 'Destination={Bucket=archive-25,Prefix=inventory/},Format=CSV,IncludedObjectVersions=Current'`
3. Copy objects to archive: `aws s3 sync s3://old-media-17 s3://archive-25 --only-show-errors`
4. Verify archive synchronization: `aws s3 sync s3://old-media-17 s3://archive-25 --dryrun --only-show-errors`
5. Suspend legacy versioning: `aws s3api put-bucket-versioning --bucket old-media-17 --versioning-configuration Status=Suspended`
6. Delete object versions: `aws s3api delete-objects --bucket old-media-17 --delete '{"Objects":[{"Key":"photos/2017/logo.png","VersionId":"v-9f2c1a"}]}'`
7. Delete version markers: `aws s3api delete-objects --bucket old-media-17 --delete '{"Objects":[{"Key":"photos/2017/logo.png","VersionId":"null"}]}'`
8. Update DNS record: `aws route53 change-resource-record-sets --hosted-zone-id Z1234567890ABC --change-batch '{"Changes":[{"Action":"UPSERT","ResourceRecordSet":{"Name":"legacy.acme.example","Type":"A","TTL":300,"ResourceRecords":[{"Value":"203.0.113.24"}]}}]}'`
9. Delete legacy bucket: `aws s3api delete-bucket --bucket old-media-17`
